messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Problem to run a Report Survey
parts:
Hi Eduardo,
two possible reasons come to mind: 1) you have species with one record only, or 2) there is species with very few records which happen to fall into almost exactly the same time of day. In both cases, the estimation of the bandwidth for the kernel density estimation for the activity density plots will fail.
You can check with
table(PMRData_survey5$specie)


Good news is that this will be fixed in the next release of the package (I changed the code already).
Best,
Jürgen
